bluf: Sempai is a Białystok based performance agency of 120 people selling Google, Microsoft, Meta, TikTok and Allegro advertising, SEO and analytics to mid market ecommerce and lead generation businesses in Poland, claiming 350 clients and 95% contract extension. It is moving early on AI channels: ChatGPT Ads management, an AI positioning service and monthly SEO & GEO reports since July 2026, and the Horus read puts it Favored at 12.5, best placed for KJ1 and KJ2. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt on its own site, and that its 25 named clients, none shared with another tracked agency, come mostly from case study slugs.
doing:
Sempai positions as a data driven 360° digital marketing agency helping ecommerce and lead generation businesses maximise online sales profit across search, social ads and marketplaces: in plain words, it buys ads on every channel a shop sells through and reports profit. The headline claim is 350 clients, 120+ specialists and 95% of clients extending contracts; the record lists 120 employees, founded 2015, offices in Białystok, Częstochowa and Kraków, ownership unknown. Partner badges: Google Premier, Meta Business and Microsoft Advertising Partner.

The sold mix leads with Paid Search (score 3): an EMEA Premier Partner Awards winner with many Google and Microsoft Ads cases and a PPC casebook. Five lines score 2 as core: AI Search / GEO (AI positioning in the navigation, monthly SEO & GEO reports, GEO guides), Data & Measurement (analytics as a homepage pillar, GA4, a Consent Mode case credited with 17,000 registrations), Paid Social (1M+ zł Meta Ads revenue and a TikTok fashion ROAS of 6,000% in its cases), Retail Media (full Allegro management, cases for Planteon and Aquael) and SEO (audits, migrations, the BRW case up 31% YoY after Google updates). B2B, CRO, content, creator and email lines score 1 with no evidence; AI automation, local, programmatic and web build score 0. Proprietary: Sempai Merchant 360 and Akademia Sempai, neither described.

Its AI posture is channel first: ChatGPT Ads management as that channel reaches Poland and AI positioning (GEO) for online shops backed by the monthly reports, no agent product on record. The only dated move is the 2026-08 note placing those reports in the main navigation; six blog posts dated 2026-09-22 cover Meta Ads attribution, the Allegro AI assistant, TikTok Shop in Poland and AI in Google Ads. The record lists no pricing signals, jobs or news. Conspicuously absent for a performance agency: any programmatic, CTV or web build line, and a client the record places outside Poland.
clients:
Client type is mid market; verticals are ecommerce, Furniture & home, Fashion & footwear, Beauty & cosmetics, Toys & kids, Books, Automotive & motorcycles, Gifts & experiences, Online pharmacy and Energy advisory; the home market is Poland.

The needs read holds 25 clients: 20 observed and 5 names only, from 8 dated case studies and 17 slugs; the mix leads with paid performance (N2, 10), organic demand (N1, 4) and commerce (N7, 4). Three rows are case study titles read as names, duplicating Planteon, kokonki.pl and BRW. Planteon came for marketplace work (2026-09-10, two Allegro accounts run at once). kokonki.pl came for organic demand (2026-09-10, SEO to TOP 1 in its industry). Black Red White (BRW) came for organic demand: the 2026-07-28 case credits a changed SEO strategy after Google updates with transactions up 31% YoY. Prezentmarzeń, an experience voucher seller, came for paid performance: cases dated 2026-07-21 and 2026-07-22 credit Microsoft Ads with conversions up 76%. dominikazak.pl (2026-04-23) came for paid performance: 1M+ zł of Meta Ads revenue in a year. From slugs: Gandalf, Hellotoys, Darmarsklep.pl and Wuber Tools for Microsoft or Meta Ads results; Kiddymoon and Bellita for Google Ads; Aquael and PPHU Eldor for Allegro Ads; Basilur Tea Poland and Marko for ecommerce growth; Cocolita and Carsmile carry AI codes from slugs naming none.

Names only, need inferred from the paid search lead: Triumfomania.pl, Bytom, Jackmotors.pl, Deezee and Omni Finances. No client is shared with another tracked agency; the Radar sees this book nowhere else.

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): it is likely, moderate confidence, that these shops ask for marketplace growth first and AI visibility second, and very unlikely that they buy automation work from Sempai, which sells none.

market:
The Horus read puts Sempai at a tailwind index of 12.5, band Favored, percentile 53, 16:49 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search, SEO pulling against, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) on the same lines. Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), driven by Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO, and KJ4 (platforms absorbing the execution layer), Data & Measurement offsetting. Best fit: The Walled Oasis at 47/100. Making P4 and P8, partial on P1, P2 and P7, absent on P6; P3 not applicable, P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 50.4, band Breeze, percentile 29: migration 46.4 against displacement 54.4. Its sold mix supplies 49 of the index, SEO (10) and Paid Search (10) carrying the most movable hours; work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 26% to Eastern Europe, automation overlapping 29% of it. Footprint observed: Kraków as a hub office, home rather than offshore for an agency in Poland. No onshore claim.
openings:
The strongest judgment is the AI visibility contradiction: Sempai sells AI positioning and ChatGPT Ads and publishes monthly SEO & GEO reports, yet its own site has no llms.txt and no audited AI visibility product shows in the record (P1 partial). A rival that publishes a citation share number for a shop in Poland very likely (moderate confidence) beats a monthly report. Falsifier: an llms.txt on sempai.pl or a GEO scorecard with named client figures at the next compile closes it.

Displacement at 54.4 on the Monsoon read says the book is likely (moderate confidence) to buy on price, and the KJ6 exposure through Paid Search, Paid Social and SEO means the hours it bills are the ones platform automation removes: an offshore delivered rival can undercut Google, Microsoft and Allegro Ads management line by line. The contestable accounts are the names with dated results, Planteon, Prezentmarzeń, BRW and dominikazak.pl, because their cases publish the numbers a rival must beat. The paid social contradiction (no social pixel on its own site) and the unknown paid search test (Transparency Center blocked) are pitch questions. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind behind its Favored band.
I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would tell whether the ChatGPT Ads line it sells as the channel reaches Poland arrives priced for its mid market book (KJ2).

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would press the KJ6 middle it sits in with no public pricing of its own.
The monthly SEO & GEO reports, July and August 2026 editions in the navigation: whether a later edition names a client citation figure tells whether the GEO line matures into a product.
